declaration.scope: Replace gamma=1 rectified-flow noise scale with gamma=2 in flow_matching_loss (and matching velocity target + sampler path).
declaration.output_semantics: Color-shift reduction and natural-image spectral statistics; measured by G0a/G0b band positions vs frozen real-FFHQ calibration.
declaration.abstention: Paper calibrated gamma=2 in latent->pixel post-training, not from-scratch pixel. Optimum may differ; sweep {1,2,4,8} if band-neutral.

declaration.scope: Replace Linear->3x3conv head with a shallow conv stack (2-3 stage DiP-style) to remove linear-head grid artifacts.
declaration.differs_from: test-stratum-no-patches (production stack, 70k FFHQ stratum, DINO patches disabled, bfloat16)
declaration.output_semantics: Removal of patch-boundary grid artifacts; measured by G0c/G0d + blind review vote.
declaration.provenance: docs/tangential-research.md 2026-08-18 Z-Image-Turbo Pixel, component 2 (JiT vs DiP)
declaration.abstention: At 240M scale a full DiP head may dominate FLOPs; use a shallow variant and profile before sizing up.

declaration.scope: Replace nn.Linear REPA projection with Conv2d + spatial normalization (iREPA, Singh et al.).
declaration.output_semantics: Improved texture convergence; visible in G0c and blind review. FID not gateable at current budget (G3 coverage is the proxy).
declaration.abstention: REPA decay completes at 16k steps in the Arm J schedule; a 5k-stride arm measures early iREPA only.

declaration.scope: Add RMSNorm to Q and K separately for attention stability (Ideogram 4 / Llama 3).
declaration.output_semantics: Training stability under long schedules and full-rank attention; NOT directly photorealism-measurable.
declaration.abstention: No gate in the G-suite measures stability gains directly; requires a stability gate (velocity norm, NaN interval) or runs as a stability companion, not a quality arm.

declaration.scope: Remove cross-attention; concatenate T5 text + DINO CLS into the self-attention sequence (Ideogram 4 single-stream).
declaration.output_semantics: Text-following and detail quality; measured by G2 + blind review.
declaration.provenance: docs/EXPERIMENT_TREE.md TBD list; Ideogram 4 validation at 9.3B scale
declaration.abstention: Largest architectural change since the patch-window series; a 5k-stride arm on 70k is the minimal honest test. Compositional risk with TREAD routing — keep TREAD off or on as a separate variable.

declaration.scope: Adapt converged ps16 checkpoint to ps32 via W'=0.5[W,W,W,W] patch-conv init + 5k-step warmup (4x token reduction).
declaration.output_semantics: Throughput/quality tradeoff; quality gap vs ps16 must stay inside gate bands.
declaration.abstention: Serves inference-speed priority; do NOT train ps32 fully from scratch (paper: slow + local artifacts). ps64 confirmed bad.

declaration.scope: Latent-space pretraining (FLUX-AE 8x) then pixel-space post-training with the Z-Image recipe (x-prediction, ps16 -> same 64x64 grid).
declaration.output_semantics: The quantified fix for slow pixel-from-scratch convergence; measured by all G0 gates + blind review.
declaration.abstention: Pipeline change for the NEXT model generation. Phase 4 per plan: only considered when Phase 2/3 arms plateau below the photoreal band. NOT selectable before then (human hold #3).
